args.description: a calm swordsman's idle loop with his drawn nodachi: he stands in the same stance, the nodachi low in his right hand with the point forward and down, his left hand resting on the scabbard at his hip; his weight shifts slowly from the back foot to the front foot and back, the knees soft; deep slow breaths lift the chest; halfway through he slowly turns the blade in his hand so the edge faces up, then turns it back; the head stays steady, the eyes calm and cold; the long ponytail, the red ribbons, the coat tails and the red tassel of the sword sway a little after the body; the feet stay planted, returns exactly to the first pose. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds, the whole body inside the picture, on an empty background. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon in a crisp pose.
